tasks.name: Clickstream Sessionization with Inactivity Gaps
tasks.reason: All correctness and performance checks passed
tasks.candidate_sql:
WITH ordered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN LAG(event_timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_timestamp) IS NULL THEN 1
            WHEN event_timestamp - LAG(event_timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_timestamp) > INTERVAL '30' MINUTE THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS new_session_flag
    FROM user_events
),
sessions AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_timestamp ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS session_id
    FROM ordered
)
SELECT
    user_id,
    CAST(session_id AS BIGINT) AS session_id,
    MIN(event_timestamp) AS session_start,
    MAX(event_timestamp) AS session_end,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count
FROM sessions
GROUP BY
    user_id,
    session_id
ORDER BY
    user_id ASC,
    session_start ASC;
tasks.golden_sql:
WITH lagged AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        event_timestamp,
        CASE
            WHEN event_timestamp - LAG(event_timestamp) OVER (
                PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_timestamp
            ) > INTERVAL 30 MINUTE 
                 OR LAG(event_timestamp) OVER (
                PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_timestamp
            ) IS NULL THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_new_session
    FROM user_events
),
session_indexed AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        event_timestamp,
        CAST(SUM(is_new_session) OVER (
            PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_timestamp
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS BIGINT) AS session_id
    FROM lagged
)
SELECT
    user_id,
    session_id,
    MIN(event_timestamp) AS session_start,
    MAX(event_timestamp) AS session_end,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count
FROM session_indexed
GROUP BY user_id, session_id
ORDER BY user_id ASC, session_start ASC;

    SELECT
        user_id,
        MIN(CASE WHEN event_name = 'view_item' THEN event_time END) AS view_time,
